description: The QLoot digital-asset economy. Four separate ERC-1155 UUPS contracts: OPT (base currency, unlimited), QTC (QlootChain, premium asset capped at 1e15) and ORT (OryphemIntelligence, AI credit: 1 request = 1 ORT), with the OryphemProxy (ORX) router governing conversions between them (1 ORT = 50 OPT, 1 QTC = 1000 OPT).

assets.name: OryphemToken
assets.role: Base currency obtained in the QLoot system

assets.name: QlootChain
assets.role: Premium asset: store certificates on-chain and encrypted messages (decryptable with a private key)

assets.name: OryphemIntelligence
assets.role: AI credit: 1 request = 1 ORT (spend to ask QLO)

router.role: Governs the network between OPT and the other assets
router.rates_note: OPT required per 1 unit of the target asset.

utility: OPT: reward for classes, quests, exams and daily tasks; leaderboard currency
QTC: certificate storage and encrypted messages on-chain
ORT: entitlement to QLoot AI services
properties.custodial_note: The treasury custodies pooled assets on-chain; per-user ownership is tracked per-account in the QLoot double-entry ledger and can be withdrawn to a personal wallet. QTC/ORT are obtained by converting OPT through the OryphemProxy (ORX).
